title: Unit 3 Consolidation: Language, Style & Word Formation

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can recognize and construct single and double possessive nominalization chains (-ás/-és, -ság/-ség).
I can recall B2 vocabulary for style, word formation, and literary analysis from Karinthy's 'Így írtok ti'.
I can convert clauses across colloquial verbal and formal nominal registers.
